# PicoChess instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before working in this repository, read and respect the root
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Before changing files in a subdirectory, also read
and respect any applicable local `AGENTS.md` files along that path, including
`uci/AGENTS.md` and `web/AGENTS.md` when working in those subsystems.

Keep shared architecture, design decisions, project information, and AI policies
in the appropriate `AGENTS.md` file. Keep this file as an entry point rather
than duplicating those rules here.
